tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// shrī ma hā ma ya'i mngon rtogs gtor ma'i cho ga dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// bla ma dang dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo// drag po 'dul mdzad he ru ka /bde chen sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma// rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor lo la// phyag 'tshal bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor bshad// dpal ma hā ma ya'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pas/ dbyibs dang sngags kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba ni/ gnas dben par bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste/ bdud rtsi'i ri lu khar bcug la/ shrī he ru ka zhes bya ba'i don dran pas/ snying khar pad ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus na/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po 'od kha dog lnga 'phro ba'i snang bas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor bla ma dang bcas pa bltas la/ 'od zer las byung ba'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod de/ oṃ a hrī badz+ra argaṃ pra ti tsa ye hūm̐/ oṃ a hri badz+ra pu pam̐/ dhu pam̐/ a lo ke/ ne pe te/ sha pa ta hūm̐/ zhes mchod yon dang*/ me tog dang*/ bdug spos dang*/ mar me dang*/ zhal zas dang*/ sil snyan rnams kyis mchod do// de nas lha mo lngas sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas nang dang*/ reg rdo rje mas bde ba chen pos mchod nas/ sdig pa thams cad bshags pa dang*/ bsod nams thams cad la yid rang ba dang*/ bla na med pa'i lam brtan cing*/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems can thams cad kyis dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir sems bskyed de/ byang chub chen po grub par gyur cig snyam pas/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma'i 'khor lo bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yid rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// bdag dang gzhan don rab bsgrub phyir// bdag gis byang chub sems mchog bskyed// e ma'o sems can kun mgron gnyer// bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba kun// 'gro ba kun gyis thob par shog

/ces brjod nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang phrad par 'dod pa'i byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i snying rje/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i dga' ba nye ring med pa'i btang snyoms yun ring du bsgoms te/ yang thams cad snying kha'i sa bon la bsdus/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nya na badz+ra swa bha ba ad ma ko ham̐/ zhes rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba la gnas pa ni bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas na tha las 'od 'phros te hūm̐ las chos 'byung gi dbus su rdo rje rgya gram bltas te 'od 'phros nas rdo rje'i rwa ba dang dra ba dang gur dang me rnams dang ldan pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom mo// de'i dbus su bh+rum̐ las byung ba'i gzhal yas kyi khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ pam̐ las pad ma 'dab ma brgyad dang ldan pa/ de'i dbus su zla ba dang nyi ma'i gdan/ phyogs su zla ba dang ro'i gdan la thig le kha dog lnga bsgoms te/ dbus su thig le hri'am hūm̐ gis mtshan pa shar rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ lhor rin po che sa yis mtshan pa/ nub tu pad ma as mtshan pa/ byang du ral gri ha yis mtshan pa/ tshad med pa bzhi'i rang bzhin du bltas te/ 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs dam bskul sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus te yongs su gyur pa las/ shar gyi pad ma las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma zhal bzhi phyag bzhi ma/ sku dang rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yas ser g.yon ljang rgyab zhal dmar ba/ phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje/ 'og ma ka pa la/ g.yon dang po dril bu/ 'og ma kha ṭ+wam̐ ga 'dzin pa'o// lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ g.yas sngon g.yon ljang rgyab dmar ba/ phyag g.yas dang po rin po che'i rgyal mtshan 'og ma tri shu la/ g.yon dang po thod pa 'og ma lce spyang ngo*// nub tu pad ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo/ zhal g.yas ser g.yon sngo rgyab zhal ljang khu/

phyag g.yas dang po na sna tshogs pad ma/ 'og ma na mda'/ g.yon dang po ka pa la/ 'og ma gzhu'o// byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu/ zhal g.yas ser g.yon sngo rgyab dmar ba/ phyag g.yas dang po ral gri 'og ma ḍa ma ru/ g.yon dang po zhags pa/ 'og ma ka pa la'o// thams cad kyang spyan gsum/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ mi mgo'i do shal dang*/ mi'i lpags pa'i stod g.yogs can/ ro dang nyi ma la dkyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o// de nas lha mo bzhis mgrin gcig tu/ kye ma gnyen mchog rdo rje'i 'od kyis pad ma kha phye cig a la la ho/ bde ba chen po rab tu dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig nyi ma'i 'od kyis pad mo kha rab 'byed pa bzhin/ a la la ho/ zhes bskul ba las skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das yab yum du bzhengs par blta ste/ sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa gar gyi nyams dang ldan pa/ rtsa zhal sngon po/ g.yas ser g.yon ljang rgyab dmar ba/ spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas dang po na mda' 'og ma na ka pa la/ g.yon dang po na gzhu 'og ma na kha ṭ+wām̐ ka bsnams pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ mgo bo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ mi'i lpags pa'i stod g.yog dang ldan pa'o// de'i yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma yang bcom ldan 'das dang 'dra ba gnyis su med par bzhugs pa'o// de nas sku gsung thugs dang skye mched byin gyis brlab pa ni/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par aḥdamar po/ snying khar hūm̐ sngon po/ dpral bar tsi ser po/ mig gnyis la oṃ dkar po/ lce la a dmar po/ rna ba la a dmar po/ sna la khe dkar po/ snying khar ra dmar po bsgom mo// de nas rang gi snying khar nyi ma la rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gi mtshan pa bsgoms pa las/ 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa lta bu spyan drangs te/

mchod nas dza hūm̐ bam̐ ho zhes gnyis su med par bya'o// de dang dus cig tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod nas/ mgon po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs kha nas lha mo bum pa thogs pa rnams kyis/ spyi bo nas dbang bskur te/ na ma sarba ta ga ta a bhi ṣin tsa tu mam̐ zhes gsung zhing ye shes kyi rang bzhin du byas te/ chu'i lhag ma las/ gtso bo yab yum la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la rnam snang*/ rin chen mkha' 'gro la rin 'byung*/ pad ma mkha' 'gro la 'od dpag med/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la don yod grub pas dbu rgyan par blta'o// de ltar dbyibs kyi rnal 'byor bstan nas/ mchod pa ni/ phyi nang gsang ba sngar ltar rang nyid la mchod par bya'o// de nas bstod pa ni/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs par mdzad// sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan// sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa// he ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes dang*/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che// zhes pa gtor chog nas bshad pa'i bstod pa gang rung gis bstod do// de nas sngags kyi rnal 'byor byed par 'dod pas/ he ru ka'i nam mkha' hūm̐ las rdo rje aṃ gis mtshan pa bug par phaṭa dang bcas par bsam/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ snying khar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar swa ser po/ gsang par aḥdamar po/ brla la ha ljang khu/ hri las pad ma bh+rum̐ gyis mtshan pa bskyed nas/ lha mo rnams kyis bskul nas gnyis su med pa'i sbyor bas sangs rgyas bkug cing zhal bzhir bsdus pas bde ba chen pos mchod nas dkyil 'khor thams cad bde ba'i rang bzhin du bsam zhing rlung cung zad bzung ba ni ye shes skye bar byed do// de la skyo na/ thugs kar hūm̐ ngam hri la sngags kyi 'od zer las dang mthun pa'i spro bsdus dmigs nas/ ā+oṃ āḥhri hūm̐ hūm̐ ces bzlas par bya'o// oṃ bhud dha ḍā ki ni a hri hūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra ḍa ki ni a hri hūm̐/ oṃ rad na ḍa ki ni a hri hūm̐/ oṃ pad ma ḍa ki ni a hri hūm̐/ oṃ karma ḍa ki ni a hri hūm̐// oṃ bhi sha ḍa ki ni a hri hūm̐/ mkha' 'gro'i bzlas pa'o// yi ge gsum gyi sgra yis ni// gzhug pa dang ni dbyung bya ba// steng du 'gro ba'i rlung gis ni// yi ge gsum gyi sgra phyung zhing*// gzhug bya la ni bcug nas su// dal zhing dal ba gzhan mi 'gro// rab tu spyod pa'i sems kyis bsgom// oṃ āḥhūm̐ rdo rje'i bzlas pa'o/ de nas lha mo rnams zhal bzhir bsdus te/ bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin mtshan ma thams cad dang bral ba/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag ltar dmigs so// spyod lam thams cad ni he ru ka'i rang bzhin du bya'o// zas za ba'i tshe me rlung gi sbyor bas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la oṃ a ghu/ h+ya bha k+ṣa hūm̐ zhes brjod la bza' bar bya'o// khrus ni dbang gi dmigs pa ltar bya'o// thams cad sgyu ma gsum gyi rang bzhin du brtag par bya ba ni chos kyi rnal 'byor ro// 'di ltar bsgoms pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thob par 'gyur ro// ye shes mkha' 'gro ku ku ri pa yi// zhal gdams bzhin du rang byung rdo rjes bris// dge bas 'gro kun phyag rgya che thob shog /rjes su 'jug rnams nyams len brtson par mdzod// skyes mchog mar pa lho brag pa'i dgongs pa dang mthun par byas so/// /sa ma pa thāḥ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i gtor ma'i rim pa ni/ rang nyid he ru kar bskyed nas skye mched rnams bsrung ba byas te/ mdun du rdo rje'i gur gyi nang du sems can thams cad dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lhar bskyed la/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi lha thams cad spyan drangs te/ oṃ shri he ru ka ma hā badz+ra/

a kad ta yā a kad ta yā/ pra pe sha ya pra pe sha ya/ bhan dha yā bhan dha yā/ to sha yā to sha yā/ sarba badz+ra ḍa ki ni nam̐/ hri da ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa zhes brjod nas gnyis su med par gyur pa la/ phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ de nas gtor ma yam̐ las rlung dang ram̐ las me dang*/ kam̐ gsum las thod pa'i sgyid pu dang*/ a las ka pa la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ gho ku dha ha na las/ ba glang dang khyi dang rta dang glang po che dang mi'i sha dang*/ bhi mu ma ra shu las/ dri chen dang dri chu dang rkang*/ rag ta dang shu trar bsams te/ steng du oṃ de'i steng du a las zla ba/ hūm̐ las rdo rje bsgoms nas/ me rlung 'bar bas thams cad zhu zhing rdo rje zla ba yang zhu ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas kha dog dang ro phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsam mo// lha tshogs thams cad kyi lce rdo rjer bsams nas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shri he ru ka ma hā badz+ra pra ti ts+tsha mam̐ bha ling ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bhud dha ḍa ki ni/ badz+ra dha ki ni/ rad na ḍa ki ni/ pad ma ḍa ki ni/ bhi sha ḍa ki ni/ sarba ḍa ki ni pra ti tsha mam̐ bha ling ta ho phaṭa/ zhes brjod nas phul bas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thob par bsams te/ bstod pa ni/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo// rnam par snang mdzad rab tu dga'// rdo rje zhi ba dga' ba che// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha'i dri ma med// dngos med dag pas gos pa med// rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje mi 'chi 'dod chags che// mi rtag nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// pad ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje dag pa gdon mi za// bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs pa// sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid las byung*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// bzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung*// ngo bo med cing gnas pa med// de ltar chos 'di shes nas kyang*// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on tam sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// zhes pa dang*/

yang yul phyogs na gnas pa rnams la yang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yul che ge mo zhes bya ba i dam̐ bha li gh+ri n+ha gh+ri n+ha/ ma mā sa pa ri bā ra/ sarba pan tsa/ sarba pa pam̐/ bya ti bhi ga nam̐/ shan ting ku ru/ dha na dha bya/ u ū a ro k+ṣam̐/ pu ti ru ru sarba mam̐/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣaḥ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ sems can thams cad nad med cing*// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sangs rgyas nyid dang phrad gyur pa'i// lam de nyid du 'gro bar shog /ma grol ba rnams da grol ba dang*// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral byed cing*// rnal 'byor bstan bcos gnas pa ni// da lta nyid du gnas par shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ mu zhes gshegs su gsol lo/ ku ku ri pas mdzad pa yi// gtor chog rang byung rdo rjes spel// dges bas sems can thams cad kyis// bar chod med pa thob par shog // bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// /
